title: Ecommerce Order and Fulfillment Service
description: Built a Spring Boot application service for inventory reservations and fulfillment transitions. Added request-key deduplication, expected-version checks and retryable outbox fixtures. Tested concurrent stock requests, repeated cancellation and relay failures with JUnit using local synthetic state.

title: Partner API Gateway
description: Created a Spring Boot partner gateway application with explicit local role checks, versioned contracts and runtime validation. Added a rolling request limit, trace IDs and distinct fixture deadline and dependency errors. Verified permission, contract, timeout and rate-limit behavior with JUnit.

title: Education Assessment and Progress Platform
description: Implemented Spring Boot assessment workflows with deterministic scores, deadline checks and duplicate-submission protection. Required instructor review for feedback and versioned publication. Tested unauthorized edits and stale approvals with JUnit using synthetic learner records.
